Note::keep_alnum¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

Note Note::keep_alnum() const

Keep Only ASCII Letters And Digits In Every Cell¶

keep_alnum() returns a new Note, same shape as the input, with every character that is not an ASCII letter or digit deleted from each cell — including whitespace, punctuation, and all non-ASCII bytes. Use it to collapse a value to a bare alphanumeric key for comparison, hashing, or slug-like identifiers.

This is stricter than remove_punctuation / remove_symbols: those keep spaces and non-ASCII; keep_alnum keeps neither. A non-ASCII letter (é, 本) is dropped along with its accent, so "café" becomes "caf".

keep_alnum is shape-preserving, cell-independent, and returns a fresh Note. A cell with no ASCII alphanumerics becomes "".

Example 1: A Batch¶

std::cout << pluss::note::print(
    pluss::make_note({"Hello, World! 42", "  x-y  ", "café"}).keep_alnum())
    << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[3], dim=1, numel=3, encoding=utf8)
["HelloWorld42", "xy", "caf"]

Spaces, the comma, the exclamation mark, the hyphens, and the é are all gone.

See Also¶

  • Note::keep_alpha / Note::keep_digits: narrower — one class only.

  • Note::remove_punctuation: keeps whitespace and non-ASCII.

  • Note::keep_ascii: keeps every ASCII byte, punctuation and whitespace included.
